rules: If a prompt is requested, a full invariant-complete prompt MUST be produced.
Silence or a transition token alone is invalid when a prompt is requested.

state_transition_rule.description: Distinguish governed prompts from deterministic state-transition tokens
rules: A one-line STATE TRANSITION TOKEN is permitted only as the final line of a governed prompt.
A STATE TRANSITION TOKEN is not a prompt and must not introduce new instructions.
No text may follow the STATE TRANSITION TOKEN.
Any one-line instruction outside this role is INVALID and FAIL-CLOSED.

rationale: Prevents confusion between instructions and execution commits
Eliminates apparent contradiction between anti–one-line prompting and deterministic transitions
Aligns prompt governance with formal workflow engines
